dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical geometric narrowing of the body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: The lateral margins are predominantly smooth and continuous with no significant asymmetrical bulges or indentations visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Visible faint, light-colored vertical linear marks distributed across the mid-dorsal surface; single high-contrast light point at the blowhole site.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Prominent longitudinal dorsal ridge along the posterior half of the body, casting a visible shadow on the right lateral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of faint, vertical linear markings on the central dorsal region consistent with healed rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible blowhole aperture on the anterior dorsal surface characterized by a dark circular indentation and a central specular highlight.
